name: Paninaro
summary: Centered in Milan's Piazza San Babila, the Paninari were known for congregating in the city's newly opened fast-food restaurants and sandwich bars ( paninoteche ), from which they derived their name.
description: Centered in Milan's Piazza San Babila, the Paninari were known for congregating in the city's newly opened fast-food restaurants and sandwich bars ( paninoteche ), from which they derived their name. The subculture was largely apolitical, rejecting the social turmoil of the previous decade in favor of a hedonistic and brand-conscious lifestyle, glorifying expensive clothing and motorcycles as status symbols.
